frozen_statements: Product-safe controls reuse RuntimeFacade; ImGui is a consumer, not an owner.
Diagnostics are read-only immutable snapshots; DebugControl is typed derived-state control; Telemetry is separate time-series infrastructure.
CanonicalCanvasSurface, ArcPreviewSurface, and DebugControllerSurface retain distinct ownership.
DebugSnapshotStamp.surfaceGeneration means the canonical Axiom view surface generation only.
Windows current Arc presenter is an independent host-scoped preview target; Debug UI must not redefine Arc ownership.
Debug input ownership latches per pointer sequence before Canvas ingress.
All queues/buffers are bounded and every admitted non-replaceable command has a finite terminal route.
Reference paths remain available until candidate evidence promotes the candidate.
P20 proof obligations are frozen; P31/P32 may materialize/execute them but may not invent terminal criteria.
